more.good_when: A maintainer who changes how the runner ends finds a test that fails when a work added just as the runner finishes its last work is left waiting with no runner to carry it. Today the case that queue.run's comment names, "a work added as the runner ends is either seen by that look or added after the lock is free", has no test: replacing `while pending(top):` with `if pending(top):` in queue.py leaves all 41 tests passing, so a maintainer could strand a work added at that moment, which the user would find still waiting in the morning, and no test would tell them.
